description: Project foundation and safety-critical scaffolding: repo folder layout mirroring the MT5 MQL5 tree, the enum-based preset/config system (Micro/Medium/Large/BigLevel/Commercial), leveled logging, the defensive order/position management wrapper (basket-aware), and the margin/exposure Safety Valve + drawdown circuit breaker. This feature establishes every low-level primitive that the engines in FEAT-002 depend on, and it encodes the non-negotiable safety semantics: gates NEW entries only, NEVER force-closes at a loss, NEVER halts the account. Independent of ML.
steps: Create directory layout under repo root: Experts/AdaptiveGoldGrid/ and Include/AdaptiveGoldGrid/. All .mqh use include guards (#ifndef ADAPTIVEGRID_<NAME>_MQH ...) and are includable via relative paths so the tree drops into <MT5>/MQL5/.

Create Include/AdaptiveGoldGrid/Config.mqh: define enum ENUM_ACCOUNT_PRESET { PRESET_MICRO, PRESET_MEDIUM, PRESET_LARGE, PRESET_BIGLEVEL, PRESET_COMMERCIAL }; define a struct PresetProfile holding tuned fields: base_lot, max_grid_levels, risk_percent_per_trade, max_basket_exposure_lots, lot_progression_factor (martingale multiplier), max_lot_cap, atr_spacing_multiplier, max_drawdown_percent (circuit breaker), margin_level_floor_percent (safety valve threshold), min_free_margin_currency. Provide a function/class CConfig that, given the selected enum, returns the PresetProfile with conservative sane defaults. Micro = smallest lots/levels/exposure, Commercial = largest. Document each field with inline comments. IMPORTANT: martingale progression must be BOUNDED by max_lot_cap and max_basket_exposure_lots per preset (never unbounded).

Create Include/AdaptiveGoldGrid/Logger.mqh: a CLogger with levels (ERROR/WARN/INFO/DEBUG), a configurable min-level, timestamped Print() output, and optional file logging via FileWrite. Keep it dependency-free so all modules can include it.

Create Include/AdaptiveGoldGrid/OrderManager.mqh: a COrderManager wrapping CTrade (<Trade/Trade.mqh>). Responsibilities: (a) NormalizeLot(volume) clamping to SymbolInfoDouble(SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN/MAX/STEP) and rounding to step; (b) defensive OpenMarket(direction, lot, comment) and OpenLimit/Stop helpers that check the trade context is free, call CTrade with the EA magic number, inspect the result retcode, and retry a configurable number of times on transient errors (TRADE_RETCODE_REQUOTE, PRICE_OFF, etc.) with a short sleep; (c) basket query helpers: CountBasketPositions(), BasketVolume(), BasketFloatingPnL(), lists of tickets, weighted-average entry price for buys/sells; (d) CloseBasket()/ClosePartial() helpers used ONLY for profit-taking (never invoked to realize a loss by the safety logic). Everything filtered by magic number + symbol.

Create Include/AdaptiveGoldGrid/SafetyValve.mqh: a CSafetyValve that evaluates account state each tick and returns whether NEW entries are permitted. Checks: (a) AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_MARGIN_LEVEL) >= preset.margin_level_floor_percent; (b) AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE) >= preset.min_free_margin_currency; (c) projected free margin after the intended next order (use OrderCalcMargin) stays positive/above floor; (d) current drawdown percent (peak equity tracked internally vs current equity) < preset.max_drawdown_percent circuit breaker. When any check fails, return CanOpenNew=false with a reason enum/string. CRITICAL and heavily commented: this class NEVER closes positions, NEVER halts, NEVER modifies existing trades; it ONLY blocks opening new grid/recovery orders to keep the account alive so the recovery basket has room to work. Expose a method to check margin room for a specific prospective lot before an OrderSend.
acceptance_criteria: Directory layout exists: Experts/AdaptiveGoldGrid/ and Include/AdaptiveGoldGrid/ with the five .mqh files (Config, Logger, OrderManager, SafetyValve) present.

Config.mqh defines ENUM_ACCOUNT_PRESET with exactly the five presets Micro/Medium/Large/BigLevel/Commercial and a PresetProfile struct with the documented fields, returned by CConfig per preset with bounded martingale (max_lot_cap and max_basket_exposure_lots set for every preset).

OrderManager normalizes lots against SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN/MAX/STEP, checks free margin via OrderCalcMargin before sending, inspects retcodes, and retries on transient errors; all queries filter by magic + symbol.

SafetyValve exposes a CanOpenNew-style decision based on margin level, free margin, projected margin, and drawdown circuit breaker, and contains explicit comments that it never force-closes/halts (blocks new entries only).
Every .mqh has include guards and compiles-by-inspection: no undeclared CTrade/account API misuse, correct MQL5 signatures.
verification: Static inspection: confirm all four .mqh files exist with include guards and resolve CTrade via <Trade/Trade.mqh>.

Grep/inspect Config.mqh for the five preset enum members and PresetProfile fields (base_lot, max_grid_levels, risk_percent_per_trade, max_basket_exposure_lots, lot_progression_factor, max_lot_cap, atr_spacing_multiplier, max_drawdown_percent, margin_level_floor_percent, min_free_margin_currency).
Inspect SafetyValve.mqh to confirm it contains NO OrderClose/PositionClose/ExpertRemove calls in its decision path (entry-blocking only), verifying the safety semantics.
Note in findings that compile verification is deferred to the user (MetaEditor F7) since no MQL5 compiler exists in the sandbox.
findings:
Created directory layout Experts/AdaptiveGoldGrid/ (empty for now; main .mq5 lands in FEAT-002 - note git does not track empty dirs so only Include/ files are committed) and Include/AdaptiveGoldGrid/ with all four foundation modules. Commit 2c43fb0.

MODULES:
- Config.mqh: ENUM_ACCOUNT_PRESET {PRESET_MICRO, PRESET_MEDIUM, PRESET_LARGE, PRESET_BIGLEVEL, PRESET_COMMERCIAL}; PresetProfile struct with all 10 documented fields (base_lot, max_grid_levels, risk_percent_per_trade, max_basket_exposure_lots, lot_progression_factor, max_lot_cap, atr_spacing_multiplier, max_drawdown_percent, margin_level_floor_percent, min_free_margin_currency). CConfig.GetProfile(preset) returns tuned profile; Micro smallest -> Commercial largest. Martingale BOUNDED: every preset sets both max_lot_cap and max_basket_exposure_lots (verified for all 5). CConfig also exposes PresetName() for logging.
- Logger.mqh: dependency-free CLogger with ENUM_LOG_LEVEL (LOG_ERROR/WARN/INFO/DEBUG), configurable min level, timestamped Print(), optional append-mode FileWrite logging, prefix tag. Level shortcuts Error/Warn/Info/Debug.
- OrderManager.mqh: COrderManager wraps CTrade (<Trade/Trade.mqh>). NormalizeLot() clamps to SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN/MAX/STEP and snaps to step. HasMarginFor()/OpenMarket use OrderCalcMargin before sending. OpenMarket/OpenPending/OpenLimit/OpenStop with magic stamping, retcode inspection, transient-error retry+sleep. Basket queries filtered by magic+symbol: CountBasketPositions, BasketVolume, BasketFloatingPnL, BasketTickets, WeightedAvgEntry, IsOurPosition. CloseBasket/ClosePartial documented as profit-taking ONLY. Added ENUM_GRID_DIRECTION {GRID_BUY, GRID_SELL} for reuse by later engines.
- SafetyValve.mqh: CSafetyValve.CanOpenNew(dir,lot) returns SafetyDecision {allowed, reason(ENUM_BLOCK_REASON), detail}. Checks drawdown (tracked peak equity vs current) < max_drawdown_percent, margin level >= floor (only enforced when margin in use), free margin >= min, and projected free margin after next order via OrderCalcMargin (fails safe = block). HasMarginRoomFor() convenience wrapper. HEAVILY commented that it ONLY blocks new entries and NEVER closes/modifies/halts. Verified via grep: NO PositionClose/OrderClose/ExpertRemove anywhere in the file.

VERIFICATION (static inspection only): All 4 .mqh have matching #ifndef/#define/#endif guards (ADAPTIVEGRID_<NAME>_MQH). Confirmed 5 preset members, 10 profile fields, correct MQL5 API usage (CTrade, SymbolInfoDouble volume constants, OrderCalcMargin, AccountInfoDouble). Relative includes between modules (OrderManager->Logger; SafetyValve->Config,Logger,OrderManager).

Design semantics honor the user's requirement: bounded grid+martingale that manages drawdown by holding/adding within limits to recover to profit, never force-closing at a loss or halting.
